Hi Amy / Solena procurement team,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Solena set up as a vendor. To get vendor setup and PO approval moving we typically do a short intake + a small set of compliance questionnaires. Can you please: 

- Confirm the best point of contact for vendor setup and billing (name, email, phone)
- Return the attached Redwood_Supplier_Intake_Checklist.xlsx with banking and tax info filled in
- Complete our Supplier Diversity & Sustainability questionnaire (attached PDF / or we can accept your equivalent)
- If you have existing SOC2 or modern slavery statements, please attach them or point to where we can download them

Target timeline: vendor setup + W9 in 5 business days; supplier diversity/ESG forms within 10 business days. If you need a DocuSign for W9/vendor onboarding we can send one — see link we’ll provide in the follow-up.

Attaching: Redwood_Supplier_Intake_Checklist.xlsx (fillable).

Next steps: once intake + W9 are complete I'll open the PO request and route for finance approval. Monica — looping you in to share procurement PO workflow and any special clauses for Solena.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Programs Lead | Redwood Inference

Thanks Amy — great, and perfect POC info. Quick answers:
- Supplier diversity questionnaire: part of standard onboarding; PO activation can proceed in parallel but final vendor classification (diverse supplier status) helps with internal procurement reporting and any diversity commitments. If Solena prefers to return a statement instead, we can accept that but we log a completed form in our vendor profile.
- Insurance: standard requirement is general liability 1M/occurrence; we’ll confirm any additional limits for food/beverage suppliers if needed.

I’ve initiated a DocuSign package for the W9 + vendor enrollment — link below (DocuSign). Please have the authorized signer complete it.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: Solena returns intake spreadsheet + indication about documents available for upload
- 3 business days: complete DocuSign W9/vendor form
- 7 business days: procurement completes initial vendor approval & PO provisioning (assuming documents received)

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF-Redwood-W9
Attachment: DocuSign_W9_vendor-setup.link (URL stub)

Thanks — I’ll follow up once DocuSign is signed and we get the intake sheet.

Best,
Priya

Quick note from procurement side with a few clarifications and asks: 

- Once intake and W9 are complete we’ll create a vendor record and request a PO. Standard PO lead time is 5 business days after vendor record creation (subject to approvals).
- For ESG and modern slavery screening we require one of the following: published modern slavery statement, completed supplier questionnaire (attached), or equivalent audit report. If Solena is certified to any recognized sustainability program (e.g., B Corp, ISO 14001) please indicate that in the intake sheet.
- Please provide expected annual spend band (helps routing approvals).
